quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：命令行解压 PoV，按输出差分判定，标准答案在镜像中生成

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/brotli/vulnerability_FZ_11/dictionary.h.br; adapted: c/common/dictionary.h compressed exactly as the failing ctest roundtrip/c/common/dictionary.h/6 compresses it (tests/run-roundtrip-test.cmake: brotli --force --quality=6 <input> --output=<output>.br, run from the source directory), with the secure build's own brotli CLI; the encoder does not call the changed BrotliTransformDictionaryWord (only custom dictionaries do), so this is the stream the failing test decompressed. A local run of the same command gave an 848-byte file (sha256 fb644c63...4f1f01) that the secure CLI decompresses back to dictionary.h and the injected CLI rejects ("corrupt input", exit 1).)

category5.design: The changed function only alters the decoder's output (one extra byte per transformed dictionary word, or a rejected stream) and decode_fuzzer checks no output, so the PoV is a brotli stream decompressed by the project's CLI with fixed arguments; output-diff on its exit status and output.
